experiments.description: Policy-search Deep Hedging on a classical GBM market using quantum orthogonal layers in feed-forward, recurrent, LSTM, and transformer architectures; evaluated by exact simulation with and without transaction costs.

algorithm.variant: Policy-search Deep Hedging with orthogonal quantum neural networks
algorithm.ansatz: Orthogonal layers using RBS gates; Pyramid and Butterfly architectures

problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize exponential utility loss L(ϕ) = (1/λ) log E[exp(-λ sum_t r_t(s_t, π_t(s_t)))]
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Action outputs constrained to [0,1] for delta/hedging position; transaction costs included in reward

problem_instance.description: European short call option hedging under a single-asset GBM market with daily rebalancing over 30 trading days.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic GBM with mu=0, sigma=0.2, dt=1/252; strike K=S0; 9.6e4 training samples and 2.4e4 test samples; evaluated on 256 simulated paths.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Classical preprocessing of market time series into embeddings; unary data loading for orthogonal layers; tomography over unary basis after each quantum layer.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Apply nonlinear activation classically and reload data for next layer; compute utility from simulated trajectories.

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper claims parameter reduction for orthogonal layers, but does not report a computational speedup metric for this experiment.

experiments.description: Inference of orthogonal-layer Deep Hedging models on the Quantinuum H1-1 emulator for classical GBM hedging, using reduced single-layer networks.

algorithm.variant: Orthogonal-layer policy-search Deep Hedging inference on emulator

problem_formulation.objective_function: Policy-search Deep Hedging utility under transaction costs

problem_instance.description: Same GBM hedging task as exp_1, evaluated on 32 paths for emulator inference.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic GBM; 32 paths; 30 trading days; transaction costs included.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Classical pretraining followed by inference on emulator; tomography over unary basis.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Utility computed from emulator outputs and compared to exact simulation.

speedup_claims.caveats: This experiment compares exact simulation to emulator inference; no classical algorithmic speedup claim is reported.

experiments.description: Inference of orthogonal-layer LSTM and transformer Deep Hedging models on the Quantinuum H1-1 trapped-ion processor for a shortened 5-day GBM hedging task.

algorithm.variant: Orthogonal-layer LSTM and Transformer inference on trapped-ion hardware

problem_formulation.objective_function: Utility maximization for hedging a European short call under transaction costs

problem_instance.description: Short-horizon GBM hedging with 4 randomly chosen paths and transaction costs.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic GBM; 5 trading days; 4 paths; transaction costs included.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Classically pre-trained models; inference only on hardware; tomography over unary basis.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Terminal PnL and utility computed from hardware outputs.

speedup_claims.caveats: No speedup is reported; the experiment is an inference comparison on hardware versus simulation.

experiments.description: Exact-simulation comparison of policy-search, expected actor-critic, and distributional actor-critic Deep Hedging using quantum compound neural networks in a quantum GBM environment.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Deep Hedging with compound neural networks; policy-search, expected actor-critic, and distributional actor-critic
algorithm.ansatz: Compound layers using Brick architecture with logarithmic depth per block

problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize exponential-utility hedging loss in a quantum environment; actor-critic value approximates Tr[O_t rho_t] and policy maximizes utility
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Hamming-weight-preserving compound layers; action observable on support covering [0,1]; distributional loss over Hamming-weight subsets

problem_instance.description: Discretized Black-Scholes/GBM hedging with a European short call option in a quantum environment.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic discretized GBM with n=1 Bernoulli variable per day; 10-day maturity; evaluated on 16 paths; with and without transaction costs.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Classical simulation of quantum circuits for training; Huber loss and value scaling used to stabilize training.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Utilities computed from simulated trajectories; best parameters selected from 3 random seeds.

speedup_claims.caveats: No explicit speedup claim is reported; the paper emphasizes better utility for distributional actor-critic.

experiments.description: Inference of the trained compound-neural-network policies on Quantinuum H1-1 emulator for the quantum GBM hedging task, comparing policy-search, expected actor-critic, and distributional actor-critic.

algorithm.variant: Compound-network policy inference on emulator for policy-search, expected actor-critic, and distributional actor-critic

problem_formulation.objective_function: Evaluate learned hedging policies under transaction costs in a quantum environment

problem_instance.description: Same 10-day quantum GBM hedging task as exp_4, evaluated on emulator.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic discretized GBM; 16 paths; transaction costs included.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Trained classically; inference on emulator; fixed depth per block used to accommodate hardware limitations.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Utilities compared across algorithms and against exact simulation.

speedup_claims.caveats: No speedup claim; this is an emulator-vs-simulation comparison for trained policies.

experiments.description: Hardware inference of trained expected and distributional actor-critic compound-network policies on Quantinuum H1-1 and H1-2 trapped-ion processors for the quantum GBM hedging task, benchmarked against Black-Scholes delta hedging.

algorithm.variant: Expected actor-critic and distributional actor-critic with compound neural networks

problem_formulation.objective_function: Hedging utility maximization under transaction costs in a quantum environment
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Distributional and expected value losses over Hamming-weight subsets

problem_instance.description: 10-day quantum GBM hedging with 8 randomly chosen paths; compared to Black-Scholes delta hedge.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic discretized GBM; 8 paths; transaction costs included; benchmarked against Black-Scholes delta hedging.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Policies trained classically; hardware inference only; terminal PnL and utility computed for selected paths.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Comparison against exact simulation and Black-Scholes baseline.

speedup_claims.caveats: No speedup claim is reported; the paper states the quantum policies outperform the Black-Scholes delta hedge in utility.
